fields.title: Mern Stack Devloper
fields.description: We are looking for a skilled MERN Stack Developer to join our development team. The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, testing, and maintaining scalable web applications using MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, and Node.js. You will work closely with designers, backend developers, and project managers to deliver high-quality applications and user experiences.

fields.title: Frontend Devloper
fields.description:
We are looking for a creative Frontend Developer who can design responsive and interactive user interfaces. The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and modern frontend frameworks.

Responsibilities
Build responsive web pages
Improve website performance and UI/UX
Integrate APIs with frontend applications

fields.title: Backend Developer
fields.description:
We are seeking a Backend Developer to develop secure and scalable server-side applications. The candidate should have experience with APIs, databases, authentication systems, and server management.

Responsibilities
Develop backend APIs and services
Manage databases and server logic
Implement authentication and security features
Optimize backend performance

fields.title: Full Stack Developer
fields.description:
We are hiring a Full Stack Developer who can work on both frontend and backend technologies. The candidate should be capable of developing complete web applications from concept to deployment.

Responsibilities
Develop frontend and backend systems
Build responsive web applications
Integrate APIs and databases
Test and deploy applications

fields.title: Data Scientist
fields.description:
We are looking for a skilled Data Scientist to analyze large datasets and generate valuable business insights. The candidate should have experience in data analysis, machine learning, statistical modeling, and data visualization to help drive data-driven decision-making.

Responsibilities
Collect, clean, and analyze large datasets
Develop machine learning and predictive models
Create dashboards and data visualizations
Identify trends and business insights from data
